correctness.rationale: The source theorem and proof were reconstructed from the full article. The two-dimensional projection counterexample satisfies the exact hypotheses and fails the lower inequality on \(e_2\). The repaired result is proved for arbitrary Hilbert space: sufficiency follows from \(\|TK^*f\|\ge m\|K^*f\|\), and necessity follows by applying universal preservation to the valid one-operator \(K\)-\(g\)-frame \(\Lambda_1=K^*\). No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
